_comment: Datasheet profile. Curve points were read off the published charts by eye and carry the stated uncertainty; labelled discharge results are exact as printed. Replace or supplement with measured data as it arrives, keeping the datasheet entries for comparison.
name: Tadiran TL-2100 (Lithium XTRA)

dischargeAt25C.note: Labelled results from the 'Discharge characteristics @ +25 C' chart. Plateau voltages are read from the chart to about +/-0.03 V.

capacityVsCurrent.note: From the 'Capacity vs. current' chart, log current axis 0.01-2 mA; nothing is published above 2 mA. Cold capacity peaks at a few hundred microamps and falls away above it; warm capacity is lost at low currents to self-discharge.

loadedVoltageVsTemperature.note: From the 'Voltage vs. temperature' chart: the voltage the cell holds under a steady load, early in life. Points are [currentMa, volts] at each temperature.

openQuestions: Loaded voltage at the 35-75 mA an SD write draws is far beyond the 16 mA top of every published curve; the battery suite measures it on a real cell at each temperature.

End of life is where the loaded voltage, at the sensed temperature and the device's heaviest load, falls to the board's minimum operating voltage (BROWNOUT_HEAVY). The cold curves above are what make that temperature-dependent.
Passivation and storage behaviour are not published for this model.
